output.summary: An evergreen tropical tree native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, it can live for more than a century. Its fruit changes from green through pink and crimson to black, has a sweet, mildly sour and astringent taste, and can stain the tongue purple; it is eaten raw or made into preserves and drinks.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten raw or made into sauces, jam, juice, jelly, sorbet, syrup or fruit salad.
